name: THE RACCOON
note: THE RACCOON, BACK IN THE HOLE (doc 111, C; errata 237): 'The raccoon has come back to Prosperity's hole, as he regards it as his.' From E3.1 (the Reverend's figure, T_SOWERBY_PRICE) until he is in Thad's coat (T_RACCOON_IN_COAT), in Act III, on the estate sale's way (not for a save that took Sheng's loan or booked the funeral with it). The raccoon's own sheet and frames, where he sat in Act I (content/ambient/raccoon.json); examined through THE RACCOON hotspot over him. He has no walk away this time: the coat goes over him and he is gone from the hole with it (`leaves`). PENDING ART: 'the raccoon in a coat, carried' and Pratt's hen are act3-estate-sale's to draw (reference/act3-estate-sale/brief.md); until then the coat is not drawn and he fades from the hole's mouth as it drops.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest · 1 breath · 2 his head turned to look left · 3 eating. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77).

leaves.note: Errata 237: the coat drops over him (doc 111, USE with him halfway out) and he goes with it.
